store.description: Play Minecraft Java Edition right on Windows 12 — no account, no mods, no setup. The launcher hosts a curated list of Eaglercraft clients covering over a decade of the game, from Indev and Alpha all the way to the newest snapshots. Pick a version, hit play, and go full screen.
features: Curated Eaglercraft version list — snapshots, releases and legacy builds
One-click play in a sandboxed embedded client
Real browser fullscreen (F11 or the fullscreen button)
Optional touch controls via the Eaglermobile userscript where supported
Nothing to configure: no username, no mods, no downloads
